functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_production_plan(p_requester_id bigint, p_location_id bigint, p_plan_date date, p_items jsonb)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_role text;
  v_user_location_id bigint;
  v_plan_id bigint;
begin

  select role, location_id
  into v_role, v_user_location_id
  from public."Employees"
  where id = p_requester_id
    and active = true;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Brak dostępu';
  end if;

  if v_role not in ('administrator', 'manager', 'su-chef') then
    raise exception 'Nie masz uprawnień do tworzenia planu';
  end if;

  if v_role <> 'administrator'
     and v_user_location_id <> p_location_id then
    raise exception 'Nie masz uprawnień do tego lokalu';
  end if;

  insert into public."Plans" (
    plan_date,
    status,
    location_id
  )
  values (
    p_plan_date,
    'active',
    p_location_id
  )
  returning id into v_plan_id;

  insert into public."Plan_items" (
    plan_id,
    product_external_id,
    nazwa,
    ilosc,
    jednostka,
    priorytet,
    gotowe
  )
  select
    v_plan_id,
    x.product_external_id,
    x.nazwa,
    x.ilosc,
    x.jednostka,
    x.priorytet,
    false
  from jsonb_to_recordset(p_items) as x(
    product_external_id bigint,
    nazwa text,
    ilosc numeric,
    jednostka text,
    priorytet text
  );

  return v_plan_id;

end;
$function$

constraints.name: Plan_items_plan_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (plan_id) REFERENCES "Plans"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: plan_items_employee_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (employee_id) REFERENCES "Employees"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: recipe_product_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (product_external_id) REFERENCES "Products"(external_id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (product_external_id) REFERENCES "Products"(external_id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE SET NULL
